newsitem.title: USA: Possis says AngioJet proves clinical value.
newsitem.headline: Possis says AngioJet proves clinical value.

text.p: Possis Medical Inc said that the Stanford University Medical Center in Stanford, Calif., demonstrated the clinical value of the company's AngioJet Rapid Thrombectomy System in treating two critically ill patients with what the company called dramatic success.
The first patient, tyreated February 5, was the recipient of a heart and double lung transplant nine days earlier. Possis' system successfully removed a blood clot and restored blood flow, it said.
The following day the AngioJet system was used in another patient to remove blood clots and reestablish blood flow.
